finalText:
Redis died. Everything else followed.

```
02:14:03  last good request
02:14:07  ERROR [api] redis connection lost: connect ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379
02:14:08  cache miss storm, all reads hit the store
02:16:46  redis reconnect attempt 0..12, every one ECONNREFUSED
02:29:12  WARN [api] request queue depth 502 (max 500)
02:31:44  ERROR [worker-2] JavaScript heap out of memory (request backlog)
02:31:45  FATAL [supervisor] worker-2 exited with code 134, restarting
02:31:52  FATAL [supervisor] api unresponsive, killing process group — service down
```

Cache loss caused 173 store timeouts. Queues grew past the cap. Memory ran out.

One catch. These logs are dated 2026-07-04, not last night.
